parameters.name: x-pryon-org-id
parameters.description: Organization ID; only required for organizations with multiple tenants.

id.description: ID of the model to use, in provider/model_id format; for a list of valid entries, see the [available models](https://docs.pryon.com/reference/available-models-for-chat-completions#/).

ChatCompletionsModels.description: A list of our Chat Completions models.

models.description: List of all the available models for our Chat Completions API.

messages.description: List of messages that form the conversation.

model.description: ID of the model to use, in provider/model_id format; for a list of valid entries, see the [available models](https://docs.pryon.com/reference/available-models-for-chat-completions#/).

temperature.description: Sampling temperature; the range depends on the product and model being called; higher values, for example, 0.8, make the output more random, while lower values, for example, 0.2, make the output more focused and deterministic; it is recommended that you adjust this value or top_p, but not both.

top_p.description: Alternative to sampling with temperature, that is, nucleus sampling; the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass, for example, 0.1 means tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.

stream.description: If set to True, the model response data is generated using server-sent events and streamed to the client.

stop.description: Stop sequence signals for the API generation.

max_completion_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens generated in the chat completion; can be used to control costs for text generated via API.

logprobs.description: True returns the log probabilities of each output token present in the content of message; False does not return probabilities.

top_logprobs.description: Number from 0 to 20 which specifies the number of most likely tokens and associated log probabilities to return at each token position; must be set to True to return this information.

id.description: Unique identifier for the chat completion.

created.description: Creation timestamp (in seconds) for the chat completion.

object.description: Object type; choices are chat.completion or chat.completion.chunk.

message.description:
The message containing the completion.
 Present only if stream=false in request.

logprobs.description: Log probability information for the choice.

finish_reason.description: Detailed explanation of the completion process.

query.description: Query provided to add additional context.

conversation_context.description: Context for prior turns in the conversation.

conversation_id.description: Retrieve context history (question-answer pairs) from previous exchanges in the conversation.

completed_query.description: Full text of the rewritten query.

role.description: Role of the message sender, that is, system, user, or assistant.

content.description: Content that has changes in the message.

Status.description: The `Status` type defines a logical error model that is suitable for different programming environments, including REST APIs and RPC APIs. It is used by [gRPC](https://github.com/grpc). Each `Status` message contains three pieces of data: error code, error message, and error details. You can find out more about this error model and how to work with it in the [API Design Guide](https://cloud.google.com/apis/design/errors).

code.description: The status code, which should be an enum value of [google.rpc.Code][google.rpc.Code].

message.description: A developer-facing error message, which should be in English. Any user-facing error message should be localized and sent in the [google.rpc.Status.details][google.rpc.Status.details] field, or localized by the client.

details.description: A list of messages that carry the error details.  There is a common set of message types for APIs to use.
